ai_summary: APL Apollo Tubes Limited reported a robust Q2FY27, achieving its highest-ever quarterly sales volume of 963,143 Ton, a 12.6% increase year-over-year, which contributed to a 4% growth for H1FY27 driven by strong performance in its core APL Apollo Brand and Roofing Products. While overall volumes are positive, a significant red flag is the more than 50% year-over-year decline in sales volume from UAE operations for both Q2 and H1FY27, indicating a material underperformance in that segment.
